issues.title: Ingest Perry County’s 2026 budget
issues.detail: The county’s 2026 budget as filed with the state (artransparency.gov, May 2026), turned into a money trail with a page cite on every amount.

stamped.revealed: $9,029,071 across 32 funds. The largest: County General Fund ($3,452,478), Road Fund ($1,784,193), Road 3/4% Sales Tax Fund ($879,000). Every total marked complete adds to its parts to the cent; where the county’s own pages disagree, the page keeps the printed number and an open question below.
